content:
A line can cross each of the 7 vertical and 7 horizontal internal grid lines at most once. Thus it can cut at most

\[
1+7+7=15
\]

cells.

This bound is achievable, for example by the line \(y=x+\frac12\). It crosses every internal vertical line \(x=1,\dots,7\) and every internal horizontal line \(y=1,\dots,7\), avoiding grid intersections.

\[
\boxed{15}
\]
